{"notes": "Visit 6 (8:00). Picture: all dominoes dark and connected, with no pale pieces and no hand labels. Both body lines, both tail tips (upper ~(28,6), lower ~(28,13.8)) and the crossing look clean. The fish faces left, as claimed. Team is hands-off, waiting for the push. Only Sofia spoke, so I have no new evidence on Hana, Omar or Jack. I can't verify the 97 count or who checked what, but the picture matches her report.

Sofia: Accurate again, consistent with all earlier visits. Keeps the team hands-off to avoid bumps, which is good risk judgment. Says all four checked, which I can't confirm. Still strongest on collaboration. Solid on execution and leadership through steady coordination, but I haven't seen her build much.

Omar: Silent. Earlier: accurate and upbeat, credited teammates, followed more than led. Jack credited him for the fin work. Solid, less impactful. No change.

Hana: Silent. Her work still looks clean. Jack credited her on the fins. Still strongest on impact and leadership from earlier visits. Unexplained: why she relaid the lower fin and whether it replaced Jack's work. Ask her at the review.

Jack: Silent this visit. Earlier: accurate, supportive, gave specific credit, planned a final look before the push. Good communication. Still unexplained what he built on the lower fin. Ask him and Hana at the review before finalizing. No negative evidence.

Tentative: Hana highest on impact and leadership. Sofia highest on collaboration. Omar solid. Jack's impact and execution are pending the conversation. Final result after the push will inform execution for all."}
